decisions.reason: The selected SK6812 Mini-E LEDs are confirmed as 3.3V loads, so the DCDC1 normal-operation role for the shared 3.3V rail must include them.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I have them with me and specs say it's 3.3, still didn't test

value_updates.normal_operation_role: Primary source for the ESP32-S3, INA219, downstream 3.3V sensors, I2C display, TTP223, AM312, and SK6812 Mini-E LEDs when the power board is connected

decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the SK6812 Mini-E selection and its 3.3V supply voltage.
The LED supply decision does not change USB enumeration, data routing, flashing, or connector requirements.
The confirmed 3.3V LED selection does not alter the current 5V boost loads, which already exclude the LEDs.
Its existing normal-operation coverage of all system loads remains valid without an attribute change.
The existing same-message MODIFY records the selected LED part; supply voltage is already owned by the separate addressable-LED power/interface Requirement.
Adding the LEDs to the 3.3V rail does not change I2C speed, pull-ups, series resistors, or cable constraints.
The LED voltage decision does not change the selected ESP32-S3 controller family.
The decision does not change the interboard connectors, partitioning, pinout, or pin-order policy.
The sensor-board connector fanout remains unchanged by the LED supply decision.
The source does not change BOM completeness, component justification, sourcing, or charge-LED BOM details.
The charge-status display method and dedicated charge-LED interface remain unchanged; SK6812 supply voltage is represented by the addressable-LED power/interface Requirement.
